<style>
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

body {
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
    background: #f8f9fa;
    padding: 20px;
}

.schedule-container {
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    background: white;
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    overflow: hidden;
}

.schedule-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 20px;
    background: #343a40;
    color: white;
}

.schedule-header h1 {
    color: white;
    margin: 0;
}

.view-toggle {
    display: flex;
    gap: 10px;
}

.toggle-btn {
    padding: 8px 16px;
    border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    color: white;
    border-radius: 6px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.toggle-btn.active {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
}

.schedule-grid {
    max-height: 800px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    background: #e9ecef;
    position: relative;
}

.schedule-time-column {
    width: 80px;
    background: #f8f9fa;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-end;
    padding-top: 40px;
    z-index: 2;
}

.schedule-time-label {
    height: 30px;
    color: #6c757d;
    font-size: 0.9em;
    padding-right: 8px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #dee2e6;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.schedule-day-column {
    flex: 1;
    position: relative;
    background: white;
    border-left: 1px solid #dee2e6;
    min-width: 0;
    overflow: visible;
}

.day-header {
    background: #000000;
    color: white;
    padding: 15px 10px;
    text-align: center;
    font-weight: 600;
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 3;
}

.event-cell {
    position: relative;
    height: 30px;
    padding: 0;
    border: none;
}

.event-card {
    position: absolute;
    left: 4px;
    right: 4px;
    background: #6c757d;
    color: white;
    padding: 6px 10px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    font-size: 0.8em;
    font-weight: 500;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    z-index: 5;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.event-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
    background: #5a6268;
    z-index: 6;
}

.event-card.architecture {
    background: #495057;
}

.event-card.architecture:hover {
    background: #343a40;
}

.event-card.social {
    background: #6c757d;
}

.event-card.social:hover {
    background: #5a6268;
}

.event-card.tour {
    background: #868e96;
}

.event-card.tour:hover {
    background: #6c757d;
}

.event-card.field-trip {
    background: #adb5bd;
}

.event-card.field-trip:hover {
    background: #868e96;
}

.event-card.tram {
    background: #ced4da;
    color: #212529;
}

.event-card.tram:hover {
    background: #adb5bd;
}

.event-tooltip {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 100%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    background: white;
    border: 1px solid #ddd;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 20px;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 35px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
    z-index: 1000;
    width: 350px;
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.event-tooltip:hover {
    background: #f8f9fa;
}

.event-card:hover .event-tooltip {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
}

.tooltip-image {
    width: 100%;
    height: 160px;
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
}

.tooltip-title {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #2d3436;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    font-size: 1.1em;
}

.tooltip-category {
    color: #636e72;
    font-size: 1em;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    font-weight: 500;
}

.tooltip-description {
    color: #636e72;
    font-size: 1em;
    line-height: 1.5;
}

.thumbnail-view {
    display: none;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
    gap: 20px;
    padding: 20px;
}

.thumbnail-view.active {
    display: grid;
}

.schedule-view {
    display: block;
}

.schedule-view.hidden {
    display: none !important;
}

.thumbnail-card {
    border: 1px solid #ccc;
    border-radius: 10px;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-align: center;
    background: #fff;
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
}

.thumbnail-card:hover {
    transform: scale(1.03);
}

.thumbnail-card a {
    display: block;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: inherit;
}

.thumbnail-card a:hover {
    text-decoration: none;
}

.thumbnail-card img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 180px;
    object-fit: cover;
}

.caption {
    padding: 10px;
}

.caption h3 {
    font-size: 1.2em;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin: 0 0 0.2em 0;
}

.caption .event-category {
    font-size: 0.9em;
    color: #666;
    margin: 0 0 0.5em 0;
}

.caption .writeup {
    font-size: 0.95em;
    color: #444;
    line-height: 1.4;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .schedule-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 60px 1fr;
        font-size: 0.8em;
    }
    
    .event-tooltip {
        width: 280px;
        left: 0;
        transform: none;
        bottom: 100%;
        margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
}

/* Add styles for overlapping events */
.event-card.overlapping {

/* Event duration styles */

<script>
// Keep only the toggle functions
function toggleToSchedule() {
    document.getElementById('calendar').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('thumbnailView').style.display = 'none';
    document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-btn')[0].classList.add('active');
    document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-btn')[1].classList.remove('active');
}

function toggleToThumbnails() {
    document.getElementById('calendar').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('thumbnailView').style.display = 'grid';
    document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-btn')[0].classList.remove('active');
    document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-btn')[1].classList.add('active');
}
</script>
